lines.en: As the morning comes, the three of us are forced to accept that this was all for nothing.

Maki is still unmotivated and un-horny, Haruka is still trying to figure out what she’s supposed to do, and I am still the same buffet of misery I have always been — just now with a side of mild paranoia.

Also, I promise that buffet comparison wasn’t one made out of sheer spontaneity. I speak (or think) to you now from the corner of a white table in a blue room with various pastries spread out before me.
Unfortunately, I’m not able to eat anything at all.
The pit has taken up far too much space.
Eventually, we leave the resort and return to our normal, unfulfilling lives.
Haruka has to work, Maki has to go home, and I have to wander the streets for yet another Sunday in hopes of finding somewhere to bury my dick until the moon shows up.
As always, my choices are somewhat endless — and I’ll use that thought to carry me forward when my body is reluctant to.
One day of rest was not enough to change anything at all.
But at least we can take solace in the fact that it was a bit easier to ignore things for a little while.
Anyway, here’s Koi Cafe.
: Sorry we weren’t able to fix you, Maki. I wish there was something more I could do, but I can’t really afford to take more than a day or two off at a time.
: Why are you apologizing? This isn’t really something you have any control over in the first place.

: I mean...yeah. I just kind of figured there would have been something yesterday that would have helped in some way. But if it’s more than just stress or whatever, I’ve got literally no idea what I’m supposed to do.
: Then don’t do anything. Like I said, this isn’t on you. And I never expected your plan to work anyway, so I’m not even let down.
: Was that last part really necessary?
: As rude as it sounded, yes. It was necessary — but not to show you I didn’t believe in you. It was to show you that this is something I’m just going to have to get over on my own.
: Think of it like a cold or the flu or something. Just instead of coughing or throwing up, I lack the desire to shove stuff inside of myself. It happens to everyone.
: Hard disagree. But if that’s what you say, I’ll just have to take your word for it. And if there’s anything else you need, don’t hesitate to ask.
: I know I haven’t been the best friend, but-
: Stop putting yourself down. You’ve been great lately and I’m happy to have you by my side.
: But, on that note, I must be off! I always say that sex toys sell themselves, but it’s not like money is going to put itself into the register, so yeah.
: Think you’ll be able to keep up the “sex is awesome” facade for a little while longer?

: Of course. I’m a great faker, you know. I’ve got at least two months left of this illusion before it starts to crack and really get to me. Until then, I’ll just keep laughing at my problems like I always do!
Welp, I guess that means I won’t be “spending much time” with Maki in the near future. Sexually, at least. I’m sure I’ll still see her around if I-
You know, maybe it would be for the best if I just left her alone altogether for a little while.
: Besides, now that I know what I must do, I might be able to turn this thing around. We’ll see!
: Of course. I’ve got plenty of experience when it comes to faking it — and I’m not about to let a little dry spell ruin my life.
: Especially not when I know what it is I must do now.
: What you must do? Are you saying you’ve finally figured out how to get out of your slump?
: Yes. And for that, I will require my daughter’s assistance.
: You what?
: Only Makoto can fix me now, Haruka. Without her, I may never get horny again.
: Uhh...
: Anyway, off to work! Enjoy your shift and thanks again for all the money you spent on me!
: Bye!
: Uhh...bye?
: Now, I know how that probably sounded without context, but I can assure you there is a perfectly logical explanation for it.
: If it’s anything other than “Maki is into some really weird shit,” I’m not sure I want to hear it.
: Well, luckily for you, Maki is into some really weird shit and we all know that already. But this actually isn’t that weird. At least not by comparison.
: Well, first off, why didn’t you tell me this before I set up a really expensive resort trip? And second, why do you know and not me?
: I didn’t find out until last night when I went out with Maki. And it’s not like I was going to wake you up to tell you.
: Well, why aren’t you telling me now? Spill it, dude. The sooner Maki’s libido comes back, the sooner her porn recommendations stop being so...impersonal.
: I can’t tell you with Rin standing right there.
: Hey! I’ve kept my mouth shut this whole time and this is the thanks I get?! I’m really good with secrets when I’m not accidentally spilling them to the people I love!
: And it is for that reason I can not tell you just yet.
: Rin, thank you for holding down the fort, but I’m going to need you to go into the back for now so I can have an adult conversation.
: You have plenty of adult conversations around me! Sometimes, too many!
: And there will be plenty more to be had in the future. But right now, you are standing firmly between me and gossip involving a good friend of mine and I need you to get lost.
: Fine. But you should know that I’m going to make you get lost the next time Otoha shows up to gossip about our friends.
: You can’t make me do anything. I sign your paychecks.
: Then I’ll sign them myself! Bye!
: That’s not how it-
: ...works.
: So anyway, what’s the deal? What do you know that I don’t?

: First off, I’m only telling you this because I know Maki is going to tell you eventually as well. Second, I am also only telling you this because I know you won’t judge me. Third, this conversation never happened.
: Is there a “fourth” or are you just going to fucking spill it already?
: There’s no fourth. Maki thinks Makoto is having sex and is torn up over what to do about it to the point where it is skewing her perception of sex altogether.
: Well, that seems pretty reasonable to me. Makoto’s still really young and-
: Oh my God it’s with you, isn’t it?
: You’re not supposed to judge me.
: You motherfucker. Give me your wallet.
: What? Why?
: Because this is your fault! And I literally paid for a ticket that you used to try and fix a problem that you created!
: I mean, technically, you bought that ticket for Sara and I was never supposed to come. So I’m just...going to hang onto my wallet for now, thanks.
: With Makoto? Really? Her dad just died, man. And you’re already on really great terms with Maki. Are you just trying to create drama at this point?
: This isn’t a new thing, Haruka. It’s been going on for a while. Maki just...didn’t catch on until now, I guess.
: Ugh. If I had known that’s what was going on, I never would have gotten involved in the first place.
: We both know that’s not true. You love drama.
: Yeah, but I also love Maki. And finding out that you’re porking her teenage daughter is really screwing with my new “I’m going to be a better friend” mentality.
: What’s your plan here? Because if Maki “knows what she must do” now, it sounds a lot like she’s going to talk to Makoto about it.
: Makoto won’t say anything about me to her. I’m, like...99%% sure of that.
: But you need to keep your mouth shut too because you’re complicit now and- what are you doing? Why is your hand out?
: Wallet. I’ll only take what you owe me.
: Are you serious?
: I spent a lot of money this weekend, you know. Money I wouldn’t have had to spend if a certain somebody knew how to keep his dick in his-
: Fine. Take it. Whatever.
: Pleasure doing business with you.
: I won’t forget this.
: Seriously, though — what’s your move? Because if Maki does have a serious conversation with Makoto about this and it doesn’t go well, it’s going to be on you.

: That’s not...entirely true, is it? Because this same thing would eventually happen even if it wasn’t me. And there’s no guarantee Makoto would just openly talk to Maki about it then either. She struggles with that.
: Wow, you sound like you know her really well. If I didn’t know any better, I might even assume you two were having sex.
: Haruka-
: Man! Why did it have to be her? You know I love talking about this stuff, but there’s never been a conflict of interest like this for me before. I have no idea what to do now!
: Just...be there for Maki, I guess. No one’s asking you to get involved with Makoto and me — no matter how much you may want to.
: Just...be there for Maki, I guess. No one’s asking you to waste any thoughts on Makoto’s sex life. Apart from the ones I assume you already waste, that is.
: Sensei! Do you really think I would ever look at a friend’s daughter that way? Me? Haruka Hamasaki? Someone who could only be described as “a great friend with unflappable morals?”
: I’m appalled. To think I would ever fantasize about fingering a friend’s daughter is just absurd.
: And it would be even more absurd to fantasize about her doing things to me. How could you even suggest that? I’m shocked. Completely and utterly shocked. I would never.
: You’re really selling it right now, Haruka.
: There’s nothing to sell. I wouldn’t ever even imagine something like that. It’s sickening. Totally sickening. Never.
: Oh, look. A customer.
: My bad. I’ll get out of the-
: ...Nodoka.
: Get out of the Nodoka? Why would anyone ever get out of the Nodoka? That makes it sound like it’s not pleasant inside of me.
: What are you doing here?
: You really need to ask what I am doing in a coffee shop? Keeping myself alive, of course.
: If I don’t get enough caffeine in the morning, I’ll turn into a demon. Then no one will want to enter the Nodoka in the first place.
: Morning, Nodoka. Black coffee?
: Yes, please. And if you could leave a little room for your phone number, it would be greatly appreciated.
: Ha ha ha. Very funny.
: She always thinks I’m joking, that one. Either that or I’m just widely undesirable by those over the age of...sorry, how old are you again?
: I’m 31, Nodoka.
: Well, I truly hope that isn’t the cutoff. I’d be quite upset if you got bored of me now that we’re...better acquainted.
: Better acquainted?
: Oh, don’t mind me. I’m just young and curious and in the throes of my first “schoolgirl crush.” How cliche that it’s on my teacher of all people.
: That...seems to be a recurring issue for your class, doesn’t it?
: Like I said. Cliche.
: Well, no shame in following your heart. Here’s your coffee, Nodoka.
: Thank you, love. Would you be able to put it on my tab? I seem to have misplaced my wallet.
: No need. I have an extra one right here.
: Isn’t that my-
: I’m also willing to...work for it, if need be. And I’m a very good worker. Just ask Ak- ahem...Sensei.
: We were actually just talking about something very similar...
: Just give her the coffee and make her go away.
: And to think just recently you were so insistent on making me come instead. I wonder what’s changed.
: What’s changed is it’s too early to deal with you right now. You’re not the only one who hasn’t had their morning coffee yet.
: Then I suppose I might just have to give you a call later...When I’m more bearable...
: Oh, Nodoka. What are you doing here?

: Why does everyone keep asking me that? I feel as if it should just be assumed at this point that I’m going to show up anywhere beautiful women gather. With priority placed on sites that serve coffee, of course.
: Neat. How’s Otoha? I haven’t heard from her today yet.
: And it would probably be best if you didn’t. She is...caught up in the moment once again.
: I figured as much. Oh well. I can wait. She’ll text me when she texts me.
: My, you’re certainly a lot calmer now that you’re sexually active, aren’t you?
: And there she goes.
: The female heart is so complicated, isn’t it? How we’ll often run from the exact things that make us feel whole...
: I’m pretty sure Rin just doesn’t want to talk about her sex life at work.
: Then I suppose that’s just one more thing that makes her and me so different.
: Coffee’s brewing right now, Nodoka. But if you want to go take a seat, I’ll run it out to you once it’s done.
: Fantastic. Will your number be arriving along with it?
: We’ll...see about that.
Nodoka goes to take a seat and Haruka...is suddenly consumed by a peculiar expression.
: Haruka?
: Oh. Hi. Yeah.
: Is there...a reason you suddenly look so different?
: Uhh...
: Maybe we could talk about that the next time you come over?
: I should...probably just get to work.
I join Nodoka at her table and talk with her for a few minutes while her coffee finishes brewing.
She tells me all about the different ways to make it.
And I’m stricken by an intense bout of deja vu that feels even more inexplicable than normal.
When I leave the cafe, I look back at Haruka.
She both smiles and shakes her head disapprovingly.
And I carry on with the life she wishes she could live while she remains stuck inside.
Haruka’s affection has increased to [haruka_love]!
